newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks likely to soften,but downside limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks likely to soften,but downside limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to soften on Thursday as worries over the financial health of companies, brokerage scandals and the future of the economy weigh on bourse, brokers said.
However, they added that pension funds were likely to buy on dips, limiting the downside to around the 19,000 threshold.
On Wednesday, the 225-share Nikkei average lost 156.72 points or 0.79 percent to close at 19,697.17.
Its September futures dropped 220 points to finish at 19,700.

"The outlook of the market is uncertain and the uncertainty is keeping investors glued to the sidelines," said Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager. "Turnover has been thin lately and for sentiment to improve, it needs to stay above 300 million shares."
On Wednesday, 355 million shares changed hands, exceeding 300 million for the first time in about a week.
